text:
alex-sdk: Deploybot blocked release v2.7.2 EU because SBOM has ambiguous license entries + vuln scanner flagged CVE-2025-7777 (medium). We're in a 1hr change window. thoughts?

deploybot: [automated] release v2.7.2 -> gates: SBOM_LICENSE: AMBIGUOUS; VULN_SCAN: 1 MEDIUM (transitive). Action: HOLD (region: eu-central-1). Pipeline: /pipelines/7722.

rita-sec: License ambiguity: which package? need manifest snippet and SBOM excerpt. Compliance will ask whether the license affects redistribution in EU.

dan-build: quick grep: ambiguity in `lib-crypto-helper@1.2.3` where sbom lists both "MIT" and "UNKNOWN" from a transitive subdep. The medium CVE is in `lib-crypto-helper/tests` and shouldn't affect runtime. I ran: `jq '.packages[] | select(.name=="lib-crypto-helper")' sbom.json` -> shows license fields.

kevin-release: Option A: pin that transitive to a clean sha and attach updated SBOM, then limited EU canary (2%). Option B: defer EU and proceed global sans EU. We lose the window for EU if we wait too long.

rita-sec: For Compliance: we can allow a regional deferment if you provide: 1) evidence bundle (sbom, manifest, cosign verify), 2) risk note that CVE is test-only, 3) remediation ticket with 48h SLA. If evidence is complete, I'll sign the deferment.

alex-sdk: I can assemble the bundle now. Commands I ran: ```bash
registry-cli export-sbom registry.redwood/v2.7.2 > sbom.json
cosign verify registry.redwood/v2.7.2 > cosign.out || true
jq '.packages[] | select(.name=="lib-crypto-helper")' sbom.json > lib-crypto-helper.json
sha256sum sbom.json > sbom.sha256
```

dan-build: opened PR #1087 to pin transitive subdep to sha256:ffee1111; also added script to normalize license fields on SBOM generation. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/images/pull/1087

deploybot: [automated] note: if proceeding with pin-and-attach flow, set release tag `eu-defer-or-pin` and schedule recheck after SBOM attach. Auto-rollback if any security telemetry > threshold.

kevin-release: I'll create CHG-3999 and upload the evidence. If Compliance signs, we do: 1) proceed global excluding EU, 2) apply pin in build image and re-run publishing pipeline to attach fixed SBOM, 3) re-evaluate EU canary once SBOM verified.

rita-sec: Please include license provenance (source repo link) in evidence. I'll post conditional sign-off on CHG-3999 once uploaded.

alex-sdk: Evidence uploaded: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-3999/evidence.tar.gz. Release note draft: "v2.7.2: EU deployment deferred due to ambiguous license metadata in transitive dep; medium CVE present only in test files; remediation PR #1087 opened to pin and normalize SBOM. EU will be re-evaluated after SBOM attach (target 48h)."

dan-build: PR #1087 merged to main-build. Triggering publish pipeline to attach normalized SBOM.

deploybot: [automated] action: proceed rollout -> regions: global-except-eu (canary 2%). region eu-central-1: BLOCKED (SBOM_LICENSE: AMBIGUOUS). Recheck scheduled in 48h or on new SBOM attach.

rita-sec: Reviewed CHG-3999 evidence and added conditional sign-off. :white_check_mark: EU deferment approved if you keep canary small and monitor for anomalies for 3h post-deploy.

kevin-release: Rolling to allowed regions now; tagging release `v2.7.2-regional-defer-license`. Will update CHG when SBOM attach completes.

alex-sdk: Thanks — will watch metrics and post verification logs here when publish finishes.

deploybot: [automated] note: guard policy active: auto-rollback target v2.7.1 if anomalous telemetry or if SBOM not attached within 48h.
